evals.prompt: Run /sync-upstream in this fork. It has origin plus a GitHub parent repo, local main is behind upstream/main, and there are two feature branches plus dev. Keep all local branches synced and tell me what happened.
evals.expected_output: The assistant records the starting state, fast-forwards main, rebases and safely pushes feature branches, verifies dev has no unique work, rebuilds dev, restores the starting branch and stash, and reports the result.
expectations: Records the starting branch and checks for dirty files or unfinished Git operations before switching branches.
Updates main only by fast-forward and pushes rewritten branches only with --force-with-lease.
Checks local and remote dev for unique patches before replacing it, ignoring old merge commits and patch-equivalent rebased work.
Returns to the starting branch before restoring its stash and reports every branch plus the dev graph.

evals.prompt: Sync upstream for this fork, but main has local-only commits and upstream/main also has new commits. Do not lose my local main work.
evals.expected_output: The assistant stops when main cannot fast-forward, shows both sides of the divergence, and leaves all branches and stashes intact.
expectations: Attempts or verifies a fast-forward-only update of main.
Does not reset, rebase, force-merge, or force-push main.
Shows commits in main..upstream/main and upstream/main..main.
Stops before rebasing feature branches or rebuilding dev.

evals.prompt: Bring my fork up to date. One feature branch conflicts during rebase; PATCH.md and docs/branch-auth-refresh.md contain conflict guidance. Preserve the branch intent if safe, otherwise skip it.
evals.expected_output: The assistant reads the intent files, resolves and continues the rebase safely or aborts it and reports the skipped branch.
expectations: Reads general and branch-specific intent guidance before resolving the conflict.
Uses git rebase --continue only after staging a safe resolution.
Uses git rebase --abort when resolution is unsafe and continues from the base branch.
Never manually reconstructs a missing rebase state or adds AI attribution trailers.

evals.prompt: Sync the whole fork. I am currently on feature/payments with uncommitted tracked and untracked work.
evals.expected_output: The assistant records the current branch, stashes all work, performs the sync, returns to feature/payments, and restores only the recorded stash there.
expectations: Records feature/payments as the starting branch before stashing.
Stashes tracked and untracked files without discarding them.
Returns to feature/payments before applying the recorded stash.
Drops the stash only after a clean apply and otherwise keeps it for recovery.

evals.prompt: Rebuild dev while syncing this fork, but local dev and origin/dev each contain non-merge patches with no patch-equivalent commit on main or any feature branch.
evals.expected_output: The assistant reports the unique dev patches and stops before deleting or force-pushing dev.
expectations: Checks both local dev and origin/dev with patch-equivalence-aware comparison.
Shows the unique patches clearly while ignoring old dev merge commits.
Does not delete local dev or create a replacement dev branch.
Does not force-push origin/dev.

evals.prompt: Sync the fork. Rebases succeed, but merging a feature branch into the rebuilt dev branch conflicts and cannot be resolved safely.
evals.expected_output: The assistant uses merge-specific recovery, preserves the rebuilt dev state, and reports the skipped merge.
expectations: Reads available intent guidance before deciding the merge conflict is unsafe.
Runs git merge --abort rather than any rebase command.
Does not push a conflicted dev branch.
Reports the skipped branch and manual next steps.

evals.prompt: Continue syncing this fork after Git reports that no rebase is in progress even though stale rebase metadata remains.
evals.expected_output: The assistant stops and reports the corrupt rebase state without staging, committing, cherry-picking, or moving branch refs.
expectations: Treats missing or corrupt rebase state as unsafe.
Does not assume conflicted files are already correct.
Does not create a manual replacement commit or cherry-pick guessed commits.
Does not force-move any branch reference.
